lessons.notes: Includes the Tema 8 “Ek kan” checklist (PDF 133, printed 129) and the child-safety / helpline page (PDF 134, printed 130).

non_lesson_pages.note: PDF 38, 72 and 133 (Ek kan checklists) are attached to lessons 80, 96 and 126; PDF 134 (child-safety helplines) is a note in lesson 126; PDF 5, 39, 73 and 105 (cycle overviews) were used for objectives and skill areas but are not lessons of their own; PDF 1-4 are front matter and were not converted. PDF 135-138 are English cut-out/craft sheets (planet mobile, folding model, “My Telephone and Address Book”): they are not Afrikaans lesson topics, are not referenced by any worksheet and were NOT converted - flagged for manual review.

open_issues: The workbook has no answer key: answers for objective items are derived from the passage/grammar rule and recorded with answer_status (official only where the workbook itself prints the answer); none are official DBE answers. Items with answer_status needs_review should be checked by a teacher.
Tema 7 has no separate self-assessment checklist page (PDF 104 is the third page of worksheet 112).
PDF 135-138 (English cut-out/craft sheets) were not converted - see non_lesson_pages.

Map, drawing, Braille and cut-out tasks (worksheets 106, 112, 115, 119, 122) are represented by interactive questions plus the original page images; the drawing/labelling itself still happens in the printed workbook.
Worksheet 119: the table lists the year 2004 for the doctorate; the text only says “seven years after returning from the USA”, so that year is derived (needs_review).

Worksheet 118: the workbook’s cause-and-effect matching grid is ambiguous in two places; the app uses its own unambiguous cause/effect pairs (supplementary) and keeps the workbook version as a writing task.
